lines.en: label otohapark10:
scene otohaparkten1
I head over to the park first thing in the morning, unsure of whether or not Otoha will be bogged down enough by the Rin situation to show up.
lines.zh: 一大早我就往公园去了，不确定 Otoha 会不会被 Rin 那档子事拖累得来不了。

lines.en: And, in the event that you just haven’t been paying attention to what’s in front of you for whatever reason, she has.
lines.zh: 而如果你因为某种原因一直没留意眼前的情况——她来了。

lines.en: Or...does?
lines.zh: 或者……她来？

lines.en: Did?
lines.zh: 她来过？

lines.en: She’s here.
lines.zh: 她在这儿。

lines.en: Albeit a bit more melancholic than I'm used to- but I guess that can be attributed to the early morning winter sun, still fighting its way through a layer of clouds much thicker than normal.
lines.zh: 只是比我惯常见到的她更忧郁一些——不过我想这大概要归咎于冬日清晨的阳光，它还在奋力穿透一层比往常厚得多的云。

lines.en: She doesn’t say anything. In fact, she probably hasn’t even noticed I’m here yet.
lines.zh: 她什么都没说。事实上，她大概还没注意到我在这儿。

lines.en: Granted, she’s one of the last people to ever notice my presence to begin with- but maybe this new version of her, temporary as it may be, will give me the chance to get closer.
lines.zh: 话说回来，她本来就是最不容易察觉到我存在的人之一——但也许这个新的她，哪怕只是暂时的，会给我一个靠近的机会。

lines.en: I’m sure it sounds cynical, but that’s the great thing about fracturing relationships.
lines.zh: 我知道这听起来很犬儒，但这正是关系出现裂痕的妙处。

lines.en: The more cracks, the more opportunities you have to fill them.
lines.zh: 裂缝越多，你能去填补的机会就越多。

lines.en: Here’s hoping I’ve learned enough from “fixing” others that I can start repairing this creature as well.
lines.zh: 但愿我从“修补”别人身上学到的东西够多，也能开始修补这只生物了。

lines.en: : Morning.
scene otohaparkten2
: Oh. Hey.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨。

lines.en: : How long have you been creepily standing there watching me for?
lines.zh: : 你像个变态似的站在那儿看我多久了？

lines.en: : A couple minutes. No longer than the typical amount of time I use to stare at you intermittently throughout the school day.
lines.zh: : 几分钟。不超过我平时上学期间断断续续盯着你看的时长。

lines.en: : You live an extremely exciting life, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你活得可真精彩啊，是吧？

lines.en: : I can sense sarcasm in that response, but I’ll have you know that my life is actually {i}very{/i} exciting.
lines.zh: : 我听得出你这话里的讽刺，不过我得告诉你，我的人生其实{i}非常{/i}精彩。

lines.en: : I am a time traveler. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 我是个时间旅行者。算是吧。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten3
: And I’m Christina Aguilera. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 那我还是 Christina Aguilera 呢。算是吧。

lines.en: : I have no idea who that is.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那是谁。

lines.en: : I am not at all surprised by that.
lines.zh: : 我对此一点都不意外。

lines.en: : Anyway, are you here to see me? Or are you just passing by on the way to meet up with somebody else?
lines.zh: : 总之，你是来找我的？还是只是路过，顺便去见别的什么人？

lines.en: : You mean somebody like {i}Rin?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你是说像{i}Rin{/i}那样的人？

lines.en: scene otohaparkten4
: Uhh...I guess? I was talking more or less about pretty much everyone.
lines.zh: : 呃……大概吧？我说的其实差不多是所有人。

lines.en: : It sounds to me like you want to talk about Rin.
lines.zh: : 我听着觉得，你想聊的是 Rin。

lines.en: : How does it even remotely sound like that?
lines.zh: : 这哪里听得出来是那个意思了？

lines.en: I’ve gotta say, I think I’m doing a pretty good job of getting Otoha to open up so far.
lines.zh: 我得说，到目前为止，我在让 Otoha 敞开心扉这件事上干得还不错。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten5
: I guess you’re not wrong, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，我想你说得也没错。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: I was just joking when I said that last thing, but it looks like my backwards method actually worked for some strange reason.
lines.zh: 我最后那句本来只是开玩笑，可看样子我这套反着来的法子，不知怎么还真奏效了。

lines.en: Cool.
lines.zh: 不错。

lines.en: : Figured it was only a matter of time until {i}somebody{/i} tried talking to me about it after what went down at the Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 我就知道，圣诞派对上出了那档事之后，{i}总有人{/i}会来找我谈这事，只是时间问题。

lines.en: : There’s no way I’m the first one.
lines.zh: : 我绝不可能是第一个。

lines.en: : First one other than Rin. Not even Nodoka or Futaba have asked about it.
lines.zh: : 除了 Rin 之外的第一个。连 Nodoka 和 Futaba 都没问过。

lines.en: : To be fair, though, Nodoka’s in the middle of another manic episode right now, so she’s not really in the condition to be asking {i}anything{/i} other than...I don’t know. Weird shit.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话，Nodoka 现在正处在又一波躁狂发作里，所以她还真是没那个状态去问{i}任何事{/i}，除了……我也不知道。一些奇奇怪怪的玩意儿。

lines.en: : Well, I’m here if you want to vent.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你想发泄的话，我在这儿。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten6
: The hell will venting even do, though? You pretty much already know everything that happened.
lines.zh: : 可发泄到底有什么用？发生的事你基本上都知道了啊。

lines.en: : Recapping it again is just going to make me feel like shit.
lines.zh: : 再复述一遍只会让我更难受。

lines.en: : Some people just like talking about what it is that bothers them.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是喜欢把困扰自己的事说出来。

lines.en: : And you think I’m one of those people?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是那种人？

lines.en: : You were certainly one of those people at the beach. I distinctly remember that occasion on account of the giant banana.
lines.zh: : 在海边的时候你肯定是那种人。我之所以记得特别清楚，是因为那根巨大的香蕉。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten7
: Oh yeah. I wonder how that banana is doing.
lines.zh: : 哦对。不知道那根香蕉现在怎么样了。

lines.en: : Listen, I’m obviously not going to force you to talk to me if you don’t want to. I just get how frustrating it might be to feel like everyone’s against you without looking at the big picture.
lines.zh: : 听着，你要是不想说，我显然不会逼你。我只是明白，觉得所有人都站在你对面、却没人去看大局，那有多让人窝火。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten8
: Everyone already knows that your parents suck.
lines.zh: : 谁都知道你爸妈很糟糕。

lines.en: : And if I were in your shoes and everyone just conveniently decided to forget that detail when I needed them to remember it most, I’d be pretty pissed.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，在我最需要别人记住这一点的时候，他们却都恰到好处地选择性遗忘，我肯定会气炸。

lines.en: : Do I even have the right to get pissed right now, though?
lines.zh: : 可我现在有生气的资格吗？

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t you? Getting angry is one of the few things we’re allowed to do whenever we want.
lines.zh: : 为什么没有？生气是我们少数几件想做就能做的事之一。

lines.en: : Not without consequences, though. And Rin’s already so heated that even a slight raise in {i}my{/i} blood pressure would cause the...thin ice we’re on to melt.
lines.zh: : 可生气是有代价的。而且 Rin 已经那么火大了，就算{i}我{/i}的血压稍微升一点，也会让我们脚下那层……薄冰融化。

lines.en: : Well, maybe you two aren’t meant to be together then?
lines.zh: : 那也许你们俩本来就不该在一起？

lines.en: scene otohaparkten9
: Wow. This suddenly sounds a lot less like me venting and a lot {i}more{/i} like you being a fucking dick.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。这话听起来突然就不太像我在发泄，{i}更{/i}像是你在当混蛋了。

lines.en: : Why would you say that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要说那种话？

lines.en: : Probably because I didn’t expect you to react like that.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我没料到你会是这个反应。

lines.en: : Of course I’m going to react like that. Even if we’re fighting or whatever right now, Rin’s still my girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 我当然会是这个反应。就算我们现在在吵架什么的，Rin 仍然是我女朋友。

lines.en: : Just because things aren’t going perfect doesn’t mean I’m going to pull the plug.
lines.zh: : 事情进展得不顺利，不代表我就要拔管。

lines.en: : Then what’s the plan? Because I’m pretty sure we both know she doesn’t want to be kept a secret forever.
lines.zh: : 那你有什么打算？因为我敢说你我都清楚，她不想永远被藏着。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten10
: Yeah. She’s made that {i}very{/i} clear.
lines.zh: : 是啊。这点她{i}说得很{/i}清楚。

lines.en: : I don’t know, man. I don’t really have a plan. I’m too busy trying to figure out how to make her stop being mad at me to plan out what I’m going to do when it comes to my parents.
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，老兄。我真没什么打算。我光顾着琢磨怎么让她别再生我的气了，根本没空去计划我爸妈那边该怎么办。

lines.en: : Can’t say sulking in a park is how I’d make my significant other stop being mad at me, but if that’s how you want to do things, be my guest.
lines.zh: : 我可不会说在公园里生闷气是让另一半消气的办法，不过你想这么干，那就随你。

lines.en: : Well, what would you do then? Since you’re so smart, I mean. How would {i}you{/i} make {i}your{/i} significant other stop being pissed off at you?
lines.zh: : 那你又会怎么做？既然你这么聪明的话。{i}你{/i}会怎么让{i}你的{/i}另一半消气？

lines.en: : Maybe...buy her flowers or something?
lines.zh: : 也许……给她买束花什么的？

lines.en: : Uh-huh. But what would you {i}actually{/i} do? Because I refuse to believe you would ever buy anyone flowers.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。可你{i}到底{/i}会怎么做？因为我死都不信你会给谁买花。

lines.en: : My real answer is significantly more sexual and I don’t think you and Rin are at that level yet.
lines.zh: : 我的真实答案色情得多，而且我觉得你和 Rin 还没到那一步。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten11
: Even if we were, that is absolutely not something I would tell you about.
lines.zh: : 就算到了，我也绝对不会跟你说那种事。

lines.en: : That’s fine because I imagine Rin would call me and tell me all about it immediately after.
lines.zh: : 没关系，因为我想 Rin 事后会立刻打电话，一五一十地告诉我。

lines.en: : You know, that’s probably true and it feels extremely wrong to me.
lines.zh: : 说真的，这大概是真的，而且我觉得这感觉特别不对劲。

lines.en: : That’s just the kind of relationship she and I have, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我想，这就是我和她之间的那种关系吧。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten12
: Then help me, dude. It’s weird saying this, but you probably know her a lot better than I do. How can I fix this?
lines.zh: : 那帮帮我吧，老兄。这话我说出来挺怪的，但你大概比我更了解她。我要怎么才能挽回？

lines.en: : You-
: How can I fix this {i}without{/i} using any of your weird, sexual methods?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，怎么才能{i}不用{/i}你那些奇怪的、色情的办法来挽回？

lines.en: : They aren’t weird. They are completely natural.
lines.zh: : 那不奇怪。那完全是很自然的事。

lines.en: : But if you really want to know, the only thing I can imagine working is backpedaling on what you said at the party and actually introducing her to your parents.
lines.zh: : 不过你真想知道的话，我能想到的唯一管用的办法，就是收回你在派对上说的话，真的把她介绍给你爸妈。

lines.en: : She said she’d be fine being introduced as a friend, didn’t she? Why not just do that?
lines.zh: : 她说过，作为朋友介绍给她也行吧？干嘛不就这么做？

lines.en: scene otohaparkten13
: Oh, come on. Do you honestly believe {i}Rin...Rin Rokuhara...{/i}would be able to convincingly act like she is not absolutely obsessed with me for even a fraction of a second?
lines.zh: : 拜托。你真觉得{i}Rin……Rin Rokuhara……{/i}能在一瞬间之内装得让人相信，她没有为我神魂颠倒吗？

lines.en: : That is a very good point.
lines.zh: : 这话说得很有道理。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m caught between like...six rocks and a lesbian right now. Which is why I’m going into like, stasis mode at this park. Because I can’t figure out what to do.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我现在就像……夹在六块石头和一个蕾丝边之间。所以我才会在这个公园里进入那种停滞模式。因为我想不出该怎么办。

lines.en: : Shit, dude. I haven’t even taken my guitar out of the case yet.
lines.zh: : 靠，老兄。我连吉他都还没从琴盒里拿出来呢。

lines.en: : Barely anyone ever comes here anyway, so it’s not like it’s a really big deal, but still.
lines.zh: : 反正也没什么人来这儿，所以也算不上什么大事，不过还是。

lines.en: : Just climb over one of those rocks and go visit her at work or something. It might not make her immediately forgive you, but it will be a start.
lines.zh: : 那就翻过其中一块石头，去她上班的地方看看她什么的。这也许不能让她马上原谅你，但至少是个开始。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten10
: It’s a little too late for that now. I’ve got lessons today and don’t really have time to stop at the cafe.
lines.zh: : 现在说这个有点太晚了。我今天有课，实在没时间在咖啡厅停留。

lines.en: : Then I guess your relationship is over and Rin is doomed to hate you forever.
lines.zh: : 那我看你们这段关系是完了，Rin 注定要恨你一辈子。

lines.en: : Welp. It was fun while it lasted. Back to dating my guitar, I guess.
lines.zh: : 唉。好歹曾经快乐过。看来我只好回去跟我的吉他谈恋爱了。

lines.en: : Unfortunate. Rin is much cuter than your guitar.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾。Rin 可比你的吉他可爱多了。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten14
: She is. But at least I can bring the guitar home without my parents thinking I’m like, mentally challenged or something.
lines.zh: : 确实。但至少我把吉他带回家，我爸妈不会觉得我……智力有障碍什么的。

lines.en: : Are they really that bad?
lines.zh: : 他们真有那么糟吗？

lines.en: : I mean...kinda? They’re not {i}bad,{/i} they’re just really fucking old fashioned and want me to be some, like...normal housewife or something when I get older.
lines.zh: : 我是说……有点吧？他们{i}不坏{/i}，就是他妈的特别守旧，想让我长大了当个……普通家庭主妇之类的。

lines.en: : Which, of course, is {i}literally impossible{/i} if you’re dating a girl. You know, since there are {i}absolutely no{/i} successful same-sex couples out there.
lines.zh: : 当然了，要是你跟一个女孩交往，那{i}根本不可能{/i}。你知道的，毕竟世上{i}一个{/i}成功的同性情侣都没有。

lines.en: : Here’s a genius idea. I’ll pretend to be your boyfriend as a cover. Then, you can bring Rin home and-
lines.zh: : 我有个天才主意。我来假扮你男朋友打掩护。这样你就能把 Rin 带回家，然后——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Wait, you need to let me finish.
lines.zh: : 等等，你得让我说完。

lines.en: : Fine. Go.
lines.zh: : 行。说吧。

lines.en: : Then, you can-
lines.zh: : 然后你就能——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Your loss. It was a great idea, too.
lines.zh: : 损失的是你。那可是个好主意。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten15
: I don’t think there has ever been a great idea that starts with a teacher dating a student.
lines.zh: : 我可不觉得世上有什么好主意是以老师跟学生交往开头的。

lines.en: : Tell that to roughly half of your classmates and I’m sure you’ll quickly find that you have an outdated outlook on this topic.
lines.zh: : 这话你去跟你大约一半的同学说，我保证你很快就会发现，你对这事的看法已经过时了。

lines.en: : Or...that our class is just fucking weird.
lines.zh: : 或者……我们班就是他妈的怪。

lines.en: : That is also a fair assessment.
lines.zh: : 这个评价也算公允。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten16
: Man, I have no idea how this even turned into as much of a thing as it has.
lines.zh: : 老兄，我真不知道这事怎么就闹到这么大。

lines.en: : I figured Rin would kind of understand that this might be an issue for us, but I guess that shit just...doesn’t even occur to you when you grow up with two moms.
lines.zh: : 我原以为 Rin 多少会明白，这对我们来说可能是个问题，可我猜这种事……在有两个妈妈的家庭里长大的人，压根就不会想到。

lines.en: : Oh. And why haven’t you met {i}them{/i} exactly? Didn’t Rin say they wanted to meet you?
lines.zh: : 哦。那你到底为什么还没去见{i}她们{/i}？Rin 不是说她们想见你吗？

lines.en: scene otohaparkten17
: Yeah, but...
lines.zh: : 是啊，可是……

lines.en: : I don’t know. I kind of want to. But, at the same time, that makes everything seem so much more...serious? Is that the right word?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我有点想。可同时，那会让一切显得更加……认真？这个词对吗？

lines.en: : Do you not think things are serious with you two?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得你们俩之间是认真的吗？

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i}. But it’s like...a different kind of serious.
lines.zh: : 我{i}觉得是{/i}。但那是……另一种认真。

lines.en: : Like...I want to just enjoy liking each other and...being free and stuff right now.
lines.zh: : 就是……我现在只想享受互相喜欢的感觉，还有……自由自在之类的。

lines.en: : If I met Rin’s parents and they liked me, some of that freedom would kind of vanish.
lines.zh: : 如果我去见了 Rin 的父母，他们也喜欢我，那份自由有一部分就会消失。

lines.en: : Because if we {i}do{/i} break up- and this isn’t me saying I want to, but if we {i}do{/i}, knowing them will make things like ten times harder.
lines.zh: : 因为万一我们{i}真的{/i}分手了——我不是说我想分，但如果{i}真{/i}分了，认识了他们会让事情难上十倍。

lines.en: : So...you think the expectations of her parents would be some kind of intangible jail cell for you?
lines.zh: : 所以……你觉得她父母的期待，对你来说会是一种无形的牢房？

lines.en: : That’s not really how I would word it, but...I guess?
lines.zh: : 我不会用这种说法，不过……大概吧？

lines.en: : I want things to just be Rin and me and...our friends. I don’t want any adults involved.
lines.zh: : 我想让事情就只是 Rin 和我，还有……我们的朋友。我不想牵扯进任何大人。

lines.en: : But I’m an adult.
lines.zh: : 可我就是个大人啊。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten2
: Yeah. Your point?
lines.zh: : 是啊。所以呢？

lines.en: : You’re always so mean to me.
lines.zh: : 你总是对我这么凶。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten15
: It’s all in good fun. I like you more than I let on.
lines.zh: : 都是闹着玩的。我比你以为的更喜欢你。

lines.en: : Besides, you barely count as an adult anyway since it seems like you just kind of stopped mentally maturing somewhere along the line.
lines.zh: : 再说，你本来也不太算个大人，因为你似乎在半路上就停止了心智上的成熟。

lines.en: : Yes, because the girl who’s afraid of her parents finding out she wants to bone a girl knows all there is to know about mental maturity.
lines.zh: : 是啊，一个害怕被父母发现自己想跟女孩上床的姑娘，倒是通晓心智成熟的一切道理。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten18
: I don’t want to “bone” anybody! What bone would I even bone with?!
lines.zh: : 我才不想跟谁“上床”！我到底该用哪根骨头去上啊？！

lines.en: scene otohaparkten10
: All things considered, I mostly understand how you feel.
lines.zh: : 总的来说，我大体上理解你的感受。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s wrong to want to create a world where things won’t get any more complicated than your relationship with one person- but that sort of thing isn’t realistic.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，想造出一个不会比「你和一个人之间的关系」更复杂的世界，这没错——但那种事并不现实。

lines.en: : And I think that you know, even if you won’t admit it, that there would just be a different problem soon enough if this thing with your parents never happened.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得，就算你不肯承认，你心里也清楚：就算你爸妈这档事从没发生，很快也会有别的问题冒出来。

lines.en: : I don’t know that. How could someone ever know that?
lines.zh: : 我可不清楚。这种事谁能说得准？

lines.en: : The only thing I {i}know{/i} is that they’re the problem right now. And that if it weren’t for them, Rin and I would still be just as happy as we were before the Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 我{i}唯一清楚{/i}的是，眼下问题就出在他们身上。如果不是因为他们，我和 Rin 还会跟圣诞派对之前一样幸福。

lines.en: : I want that back.
lines.zh: : 我想把那份幸福找回来。

lines.en: : I don’t like where we are now.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢我们现在的状态。

lines.en: : Then go somewhere else. Do something about it.
lines.zh: : 那就换个地方。做点什么去改变它。

lines.en: : How much of what you’ve told me today have you told her?
lines.zh: : 你今天跟我说的这些，你跟她说了多少？

lines.en: : To be totally honest...not a lot.
lines.zh: : 老实说……不多。

lines.en: : But she’s hard to talk to about stuff like this. I don’t want her to internalize it and think it’s all on her when, in all actuality, it’s my...indecisiveness that’s creating these problems.
lines.zh: : 可这种事很难跟她说。我不想让她把话往心里去，觉得全是她的问题，可实际上，制造这些麻烦的是我的……优柔寡断。

lines.en: : {i}Tell her that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就这么告诉她。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, because the whole, “It’s me, not you” thing always goes over so well in movies.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为电影里那套“是我的问题，不是你的”从来都特别管用。

lines.en: : This isn’t a movie, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 这不是电影，Otoha。

lines.en: : Good, because this movie would fucking suck.
lines.zh: : 那还好，因为这电影要是拍出来肯定烂透了。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha doesn’t say anything that I didn’t already expect to hear when I approached her today.
lines.zh: Otoha 说的每一句话，都没有超出我今天找上她之前就已经预料到的范围。

lines.en: And while there was minimal refilling of cracks or fixing of anything, I did manage to learn that at least she doesn’t dislike me as much as she lets on.
lines.zh: 虽说裂缝没填上多少、也没修好什么，但我至少弄清了一件事：她并不像表现出来的那么讨厌我。

lines.en: But of course that’s what I’d jump to since it’s the only detail pertaining to me I was able to siphon out of the entire conversation.
lines.zh: 当然，我第一时间想到的就是这个，因为这是整段对话里我唯一能榨出来的、跟我有关的细节。

lines.en: I’m not involved in this. It’s not my {i}place{/i} to be involved in this.
lines.zh: 这事与我无关。掺和进来本就不是我的{i}位置{/i}。

lines.en: I’m simply observing what could be either the earliest stages of a potential fallout...or the first of many hurdles in a long and successful relationship.
lines.zh: 我只是在旁观，看着这可能是一场决裂的最初阶段……也可能是一段长久而成功的关系中诸多障碍的第一道。

lines.en: Unfortunately, this world doesn’t have enough long and successful relationships.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，这个世界里长久而成功的关系并不够多。

lines.en: In fact, I can’t put my finger on a single one- but that’s mostly due to the fact that my fingers belong closer to short term options than ones that will grow old beside me.
lines.zh: 事实上，我一个都想不出来——但这多半是因为我的手指更适合伸向短期选项，而不是那些会陪我一起变老的人。

lines.en: In that sense, I wish Otoha the best in her pursuit of eternal youth or eternal freedom or whatever it is that she wants to last forever.
lines.zh: 从这个意义上说，我祝 Otoha 好运，祝她追求到永恒青春也好、永恒自由也好，或者任何她想让它永不消逝的东西。

lines.en: My wishes fall on deaf ears, but that’s okay-
lines.zh: 我的祝愿无人听取，不过没关系——

lines.en: Because those things might be closer than she’s willing to believe.
lines.zh: 因为那些东西，也许比她愿意相信的更近。

lines.en: Those wishes might come true.
lines.zh: 那些愿望也许会成真。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten19
: Okay, well...I need to start heading out. But thanks for dropping by and letting me vent.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那个……我得走了。不过谢谢你过来，还听我发泄。

lines.en: : Didn’t really sound fun at first, but I guess it did kind of help.
lines.zh: : 一开始听着不太好玩，不过我想确实有点用。

lines.en: : I’m gonna text Rin and see if she’s able to talk about this tonight. I probably should be filling her in on some of the stuff I said to you if I really do want this relationship to work out.
lines.zh: : 我打算发消息给 Rin，看她今晚能不能聊聊这事。如果我真想让这段关系走下去，大概该把跟你说的那些话也告诉她一些。

lines.en: : I’m glad I was able to help in...whatever way I was able to help.
lines.zh: : 很高兴我能帮上忙……不管是以什么方式帮上的。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten20
: Cool. So, uhh...
: See you later, then.
lines.zh: : 那回头见。

lines.en: : You’re not going to ask me for like...a goodbye hug or something, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会要跟我来个……告别拥抱什么的吧？

lines.en: : I am not.
lines.zh: : 我不会。

lines.en: : Then...why are you not leaving?
lines.zh: : 那……你为什么不走？

lines.en: : Because I’m going to come with you to your lesson.
lines.zh: : 因为我要跟你一起去上课。

lines.en: : No. You’re not.
lines.zh: : 不行。你不能去。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？

lines.en: : Because I don’t want you to be there.
lines.zh: : 因为我不想让你在场。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} might not want me to be there, but I’m not so sure your vocal coach feels the same way.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}也许不想让我在场，可我不太确定你的声乐老师是不是也这么想。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten21
: Why do you even want to come? It’s going to be totally boring and that basement is cold as shit.
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么想去？那肯定无聊透顶，而且那地下室冷得要死。

lines.en: : I don’t have anything else to do today. And also, Niki confessed to still being in love with me and I thought it might be nice to drop by unannounced and make her blush.
lines.zh: : 我今天没别的事可做。再说，Niki 跟我坦白说她还爱着我，我想不如不打招呼就过去，让她脸红一下。

lines.en: : Besides, it’ll also give you an opportunity to see how a real couple deals with their issues.
lines.zh: : 再说，这也能让你有机会看看，一对真正的情侣是怎么处理他们的问题的。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten22
: Wait, are you two actually back together?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们俩真的复合了？

lines.en: : No. But we act like we are sometimes, and I think that should be good enough.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过我们有时候表现得像复合了一样，我觉得这就够了。

lines.en: scene otohaparkten23
: Ugh...whatever. I know there’s no stopping you once you decide to actually do something, and I’m already running late.
lines.zh: : 呃……随便你吧。我知道你一旦真决定要做什么，谁也拦不住，而且我已经要迟到了。

lines.en: : I’m warning you now, though- it really is going to be boring. And if you do anything to mess up the lesson, I’m never talking to you again.
lines.zh: : 不过我先警告你——那真的会很无聊。而且你要是敢搞砸我的课，我就再也不理你了。

lines.en: : I need this, dude. It’s an amazing opportunity. Please don’t mess it up for me.
lines.zh: : 我很需要这堂课，老兄。这是个难得的机会。求你别给我搞砸了。

lines.en: : Otoha, why would I ever mess {i}anything{/i} up for you?
lines.zh: : Otoha，我怎么会去搞砸{i}任何{/i}你的事呢？

lines.en: : That emphasis on {i}anything{/i} is really starting to make me worry, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你对{i}任何{/i}这两个字的重音，真的开始让我担心了，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
: Don’t worry at all, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 完全不用担心，Otoha。

lines.en: : If there is anything I am good at, it is spending time with Niki without causing her to get flustered or angry at anyone.
lines.zh: : 如果说我有什么擅长的事，那就是跟 Niki 待在一起，而不让她慌神、也不让她对任何人发火。

lines.en: : I swear to God...
lines.zh: : 我对天发誓……

lines.en: $ otohapark10 = True
$ otoha_love += 1
{i}Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]！{/i}
